text: This Program is committed to train the senior professionals, who have solid foundation of Marxist economics, are familiar with the modern western economic theory and grasp skillfully the analyzing methods of modern economics. The Program systematically introduces fundamental economics knowledge; movement mechanism of the market economy, history and present situation of national and foreign economy, and academic development trend of the economics. Major benefits for students: The students are expected to grasp fundamental theories and analyzing method of Marxist economics, contemporary western economics, grasp analyzing method of modern economics, learn academic development tendency and the application prospect of domestic and foreign economics, understand the restructure of Chinese economy and the economical development be familiar with the economical principles, policies, laws and relegations of Party and China, grasp the basic research methods. Main Courses Microeconomics, Macroeconomics, Accounting, Statistics, Econometrics, International Economics, Monetary and Banking, Public Finance, Development Economics, Marketing
